name: Shirakawa Hiyori
source: [spoiler]She have an ability to see other people flag with other people and manipulate it, but she can't see her flag with her ability. To manipulate other people flag to have strong connection with other people flag, she use 2 gun where the left gun is targeted flag and right gun is herself. Because her ability is not perfect and it is the result of mana unstable state in Mizu country, she must use another connection to manipulate other people flag. But to cover this demerit, she use her connection itself every time she want to make other people romantic feeling become more solid. Based on Ichito, her ability is not from magic category.[/spoiler]
